player_prompt.intro:
Tqadart ad turar tamawt n wuṭṭunen n Countdown!
Injah: Rmesten wuṭṭunen s +, -, *, / akken ad taweḍ taɣmert.
Tallalt n tawla: [i j op] anda i,j d tansa n wuṭṭunen, op d tawla.
Umalal: [0 2 *] ittajmaɛ wuṭṭun s tansa 0 d wuṭṭun s tansa 2.
Aẓlay s iswi n wuṭṭunen imḍebbern kan.
